'''2008 Pennsylvania State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 19 July 2008 at Mr. Nice Guy Games, 802 Allegheny River Blvd., Oakmont, Pennsylvania, organized by [[Dan Tartaglione]].<ref name="sf-21495-310266">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=310266#p310266 PA States], DTartagOne (Dan Tartaglione), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (27 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191646/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21495.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-21495-315241">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315241#p315241 PA States], Shewski (Mike Tomashewski), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (14 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191646/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21495.html Internet Archive]</ref> Tartaglione received the event's bye into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Organization ==

Tartaglione announced the date and store on 27 June 2008: registration from noon, when the store opened, and play from 1 pm; of the $20 entry fee, $5 would go to the store as store credit and the rest to prizes.<ref name="sf-21495-310266" /> He confirmed that it would be six games and a final confrontation.<ref name="sf-21495-310384">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=310384#p310384 PA States], DTartagOne (Dan Tartaglione), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (27 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191646/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21495.html Internet Archive]</ref> The event had been moved from 5 July to 19 July because of his work schedule.<ref name="sf-21495-311397">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311397#p311397 PA States], DTartagOne (Dan Tartaglione), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (1 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191646/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21495.html Internet Archive]</ref> Decklists were required.<ref name="sf-21495-314500">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=314500#p314500 PA States], DTartagOne (Dan Tartaglione), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191646/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21495.html Internet Archive]</ref> When players objected to a $20 entry for a small turnout, he agreed to lower the fee for a smaller group, and wrote that it would not rise above $20.<ref name="sf-21495-314782">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=314782#p314782 PA States], DTartagOne (Dan Tartaglione), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (13 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191646/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21495.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-21495-314787">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=314787#p314787 PA States], DTartagOne (Dan Tartaglione), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (13 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125191646/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21495.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Mr. Nice Guy Games, 802 Allegheny River Blvd., Oakmont, Pennsylvania<ref name="sf-21495-310266" />
* '''Dates:''' 19 July 2008<ref name="sf-21495-310266" />
* '''Time:''' registration from 12:00 noon, start at 1:00 pm<ref name="sf-21495-310266" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, six games and a final confrontation; decklists required<ref name="sf-21495-310384" /><ref name="sf-21495-314500" />
* '''Entry fee:''' up to $20<ref name="sf-21495-310266" /><ref name="sf-21495-314787" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Dan Tartaglione]]<ref name="sf-21495-310266" /><ref name="sf-21495-315241" />
* '''Day 2 bye:''' [[Dan Tartaglione]]<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
